results.title: The Philippine Coast Guard conducted a maritime domain awareness flight over Bajo de Masinloc or Scarborough Shoal in the West Philippine Se
results.description:
The Philippine Coast Guard conducted a maritime domain awareness flight over Bajo de Masinloc or Scarborough Shoal in the West Philippine Sea on Tuesday.  

Even before reaching the shoal, radio challenges could already be heard between the Philippine Air Force, which was also conducting an MDA flight, and China’s People’s Liberation Army Air Force and PLA Navy.  

Two buoys and a floating barrier were spotted still in place at Bajo de Masinloc. 

 A Chinese research vessel, a PLA Navy warship, and a Chinese maritime militia vessel were also seen operating outside the shoal. | #SelfiePatrol ni @biancadava

results.title: The Philippines' sinking ship @BRPSierraMadre can only be kept afloat by lies—deceiving Filipinos into believing we don't need China's permi
results.description:
The Philippines' sinking ship @BRPSierraMadre can only be kept afloat by lies—deceiving Filipinos into believing we don't need China's permission, while simultaneously having to obtain Chinese approval for humanitarian aid. 
Given the Philippines' past practice of secretly stashing cement and rebar during fake humanitarian deliveries, China's maritime police should strengthen boarding inspections of supply vessels.
